Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.onchain

Class BitcoinCoreRpcClient

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.onchain.BitcoinCoreRpcClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockchainClient
@Primary @Component("kfeBitcoinCoreRpcClient") @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="bitcoin.rpc", name="enabled", havingValue="true") public class BitcoinCoreRpcClient extends Object implements BlockchainClient
Bitcoin Core JSON-RPC adapter for node and wallet operations used by KFE on-chain flows.

Wallet-scoped calls use the configured wallet endpoint; chain-wide calls use the node endpoint. The adapter preserves negative confirmation values and distinguishes RPC failures from a genuine not-found result so callers do not accidentally release financial reserves.

    • findTransactionConfirmations

      public OptionalInt findTransactionConfirmations(String txid)
      Confirmation count for a wallet-known or mempool/chain transaction. Empty when the transaction is not found; 0 means in mempool (unconfirmed).

      Negative values are preserved from Bitcoin Core and carry specific meaning:

      • -1: CONFLICTED — double-spend or conflicting transaction exists
      • -2: REMOVED — transaction no longer in mempool (RBF replaced, evicted)
      • -3 or lower: other Core-specific negative states
      Callers must handle negative confirmations explicitly — conflating with zero hides reorgs.
      Specified by:
      findTransactionConfirmations in interface BlockchainClient
      Parameters:
      txid - transaction identifier
      Returns:
      confirmation count, including negative counts for conflicted transactions, or empty
